messages:
maria: Heads up — eu-west-2 GPU pool failing to join since 06:12. Keystore decryption timeouts + VPC default-deny FW rolled last night.

sam: seeing the same. kube-join logs show `decrypt: KMSGrantAccessDenied` and `tcp 443 connection reset` to keystore.

maria: Pasted kube log:
```text
2026-03-22T06:13:02Z kubelet[2145]: attach: decrypt failed: KMSGrantAccessDenied
2026-03-22T06:13:03Z network: egress reset to 10.2.5.21:443
```

jin: firewall change ID fw-roll-2026-03-22 applied at 02:04 — it's blocking egress to keystore endpoint 10.2.5.21:443 (rule: default-deny + allow-https-from-controlplane removed)

adrian: security flagged FW because of PCI audit scope. We can't open whole subnet. Need very scoped allowlist and audit trail.

maria: Short-term we could add SG rule for keystore ip + prefer privatelink? privatelink isn't available in eu-west-2 on this account — routing via NAT GW will incur heavy egress costs.

leila: quick cost calc: warm-pool syncs ~1.8TB/day. NAT egress ~$0.09/GB => ~ $160/day just for keystore traffic if we proxy. That scales badly.

security-bot: policy: "no broad egress to 0.0.0.0/0" — exceptions require audit ticket + approver + rollback plan.

sam: proposal: (1) allow SG egress to keystore CIDR 10.2.5.21/32 only; (2) run a 5-node canary in eu-west-2; (3) backfill from us-west-2 for critical capacity if canary fails; (4) short-term keystore grant retry config.

jin: backfilling reduces locality SLA (tokens, KV cache misses) — expect latency bump. Ops suggests canary first: +5 nodes, monitor for 30m.

adrian: security can approve a scoped SG exception for 24h with high-fidelity audit logging and packet captures. Need justification and a rollback.

maria: I'll open the exception ticket and the runbook now, then trigger canary. I'll capture tcpdump + keystore logs.

leila: also enable audit sampling=high for next 12h so compliance reviewers get full context. Will track incremental cost.

sam: if canary looks good we can scale warm-pool to salvage capacity. If not, fallback: redirect non-prod/low-priority jobs to dedicated_reserved pools.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: 5-node canary requested by maria queued — job id: cb-20260322-77.

maria: action items: (1) maria create exception ticket (2) adrian approve scoped SG (3) jin run canary (4) leila monitor cost & audit logs (5) sam prepare fallback. tagging @adrian @jin @leila

adrian: Approved the scoped SG exception for 24h — ticket #INC-1248. Rollback scheduled 2026-03-23T09:00Z.

maria: canary succeeded after 12m. nodes joined and kubelet decrypt errors cleared. Keeping exception open until we push a config patch.

sam: next steps: patch keystore routing to prefer a privatelink endpoint in eu-west-2 (if available) or deploy a read-only local keystore replica. Cost/ops impact analysis due EOD.

leila: FYI finance: provisional NAT cost if we need full re-route (worst-case) estimated ~$4k/week. Please confirm emergency spend approval.

security-bot: exception logged; reviewers assigned: compliance-team, infra-audit. Please upload tcpdump + keystore logs to the ticket.

maria: closing loop — will post a follow-up thread with perf/regression numbers and final remediation plan. Thanks all.
